Same visible course entry with existing missions/course navigation.
Neutral case title, stated routing observations and clearly conceptual mechanism figure.
Readable scenario and body scrolling to its complete figure; fixed navigation does not permanently hide content.
Two-column semantic decisions/reasons, horizontal radio labels at16px, visible assistance and terminal actions.
Single-column controls, clear disabled-submit label and reachable abandon/help above reserved footer.
Centered native SavvyShark briefing with blur, readable rules and explicit close/start.
Actual incorrect first: both criteria false and specific decisive requirement, without readiness claim.
Selected alternatives marked; explanatory and counterfactual feedback remains readable by scrolling.
Actual Computing commitment case: separate decision/reason controls and visible draft/help/abandon.
Actual correct first in the pricing family: matching pair and qualified baseline explanation.
Actual Service Types two-valid-hosts case: supported choices and explicit retained responsibilities.
Actual submitted valid PaaS pair: both criteria true; other valid pair is explained only after submission.
Full valid1197-event history: explicit bound explanation, disabled new Start and retained submissions.
Latest historical selection399 retains native select focus and uniquely named current/history regions; independent Axe0.
Denied transfer aid withholds authored SaaS guide/criteria/explanation while actual account controls remain available.
Corrupt transfer is isolated with named recovery; fictional SaaS inventory remains intact.
Old aided practical rationale withheld by durable transfer preflight; own response/terminal controls stay reachable in the scrolling pane.

content.finding: Read all nineteen authored items, feedback/counterfactuals and retained teaching; separate blinded solutions matched all twenty accepted pairs. Pre-answer rule cues and local ambiguity were corrected. Current official primary-source qualifications support the scoped content claims; human SME/learning validation remains unperformed.

technical.finding: Independently recomputed final normalized hashes and fingerprint, checked the frozen reviewed source/test hashes and preserved paths. New replay, durable writes/readback, stale comparison, terminal reserve and isolated recovery preserve old evidence, XP and technical stores.

visual.finding: Representative actual production images and all corrected held/history/recovery views were inspected. Ten held views passed Axe and sixty viewport containment checks; controls remained usable, neutral recovery headings/landmarks are correct, and initial/retry/draft/result focus is verified. No visual major; human UX/screen-reader approval is unperformed.

assessment.finding: Matching decision and structured reason are required, including both valid-host pairs and rejected crossed reasons. Initial/help/retry/abandon and immutable submitted prefixes remain separate. Direct pre-answer rules were removed; the finite bank is not measured evidence of broad transfer or exam readiness.

guidance.finding: The confirmed standalone SaaS/old-practical bypass is fixed with all-context automatic suppression and durable common teaching preflight. Denied/corrupt/conflicted contexts withhold answers, already-open guidance disappears on conflict, and own independent inputs/terminal controls remain available without implicit aid.

regression.finding: Reviewer pure tests and actual bounded closure probes passed; the complete held-state sweep passed without page errors or overflow. Author final full check and full production E2E are recorded separately from reviewer executions. Interrupted intermediate suites are not full passes; no new skip or weakened assertion was introduced.

findings.description: Standalone SaaS guidance and old practical answer-bearing outcomes bypassed transfer assistance/uncertainty guards.
findings.fix: SaaS automatic guidance now requires the complete safe context, while retained explanation, practical progress and eligible outcomes use durable teaching preflight. Own operations and unaided controls remain separate; denied/corrupt/already-open conflict probes pass.

findings.description: Two independent prompts supplied the conceptual reason rule before reason selection.
findings.fix: Manual drift and repeated error now supply neutral observed source/state/chronology facts; conceptual principles remain in post-submit/help feedback. Separate blind solution review and scoped correction verification found no extra valid pair.

findings.description: An exhausted valid completed log left Start enabled without an explanation.
findings.fix: Start follows the domain reservation threshold, shows a neutral capacity explanation and remains disabled while historical results and lesson return stay available.

findings.description: Current and selected historical feedback could have identical accessible region names.
findings.fix: Localized current/history labels distinguish the two regions even for the same latest attempt; history-open Axe passes.

findings.description: Memory premise cueing, an implausible grouping distractor and an unclear SaaS actor weakened local items.
findings.fix: Memory uses a delivery constraint, payment uses distinct Resource groups with the same endpoint, and the SaaS wrong reason names the supplier actor explicitly. Corrected content retains the accepted pairs.

findings.description: Multiple held teaching surfaces created duplicate named recovery landmarks.
findings.fix: The common fallback remains ordinary section content with visible heading/status and scoped controls, without a redundant shared region name; denied/corrupt SaaS Axe passes.

findings.description: A held outer course boundary also removed the page H1.
findings.fix: Only outer course recovery uses the existing neutral H1; nested and Journal recovery stays H2. Blocked Summary/history Axe and viewport checks pass.

findings.description: Independent practical controls outside main lacked a landmark.
findings.fix: The existing independent practical section is a named region using its existing learner-facing label; actual held-form Axe and abandonment hit testing pass.

findings.description: An inactive saved transfer preference overrode an older active root Resume destination.
findings.fix: Only active transfer has top priority; inactive exact-case fallback follows all existing active contexts. Actual older Benefits/lab/no-active root clicks preserve learner and XP bytes.

findings.description: Starting a same-case retry could leave focus on BODY because its scenario heading remained mounted.
findings.fix: Only the scenario heading is keyed by attempt identity. Actual initial/retry scenario focus, stable radio focus during drafts, result focus and immutable old event prefixes pass.

findings.description: The finite bank includes easy careful-process alternatives. Difficulty, discrimination, novice resistance to cues, broad unseen transfer and human SME/UX/screen-reader approval remain unperformed; no readiness or learner-mastery inference is accepted.
